It is a HISTORICAL PAINTING and not an icon, by Alexandre Cabanel, in the Cleveland Museum of Art, which Commons releases CC0 — the §5 rule that a painting may fill a hero slot where no icon exists, author recorded. Its subject is Aglae and Boniface, the Roman matron and the servant she sent to Tarsus for relics, which is this folder: display name Aglaia of Rome, stored «Aglaia» and «Αγλαΐα», kept with Boniface. A TWO-FIGURE scene, not a portrait, and the companion folder boniface-of-tarsus is given a different picture so the two days do not show the same canvas. 5082x4618.
